amendment_01.fault_rule: A field value is reported `fault` ONLY if it faults in EVERY attempt of the revalidate pass AND the baselines bracketing it were healthy. `transient_not_reproduced` / `intermittent` / `victim` outcomes are recorded but EXCLUDED from the field verdicts.
amendment_01.reason: experiments/FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL.md gained a new binding SS7 (`Concurrent sweeps CONTAMINATE each other`) AFTER this experiment's contract was frozen and AFTER gated run01 had already completed. EXP-0143 and EXP-0147 independently found sibling GPU experiments' contained faults surfacing as failures in an unrelated agent's command buffers.
amendment_01.run01_status: COMPLETE under the ORIGINAL contract (29,685/29,685 cases, 0 hangs, matrix_sha256 match). Retained unmodified. It carries no `err`/`victim` fields and no periodic baseline log; that is a disclosed limitation of run01, and the revalidate pass covers its faults.
what_changed: harness/sweeprun.py: records the OS `[cb error] localizedDescription`; adds is_victim() classification and Carrier.restart() for cascade escape.

harness/run.py: every record now carries `err`/`err2`/`victim`; the UNMUTATED baseline of the current arm is re-validated every 250 cases into raw/<run>/03_baseline.jsonl, with up to 3 attempts and a runner restart between them; 02_summary.json records baseline_cascades and the declared concurrent experiments.

harness/revalidate.py: NEW third pass that re-executes every case that produced a non-OK status in ANY gated run, `--repeats` times in a fresh process, with a baseline check before and after each case.
amendment_01.what_did_NOT_change: The CASE MATRIX. `harness/casematrix.py` and both kernel files are byte-identical to the frozen contract, so `matrix_sha256` is unchanged and run01 and run02 remain directly comparable. The amendment adds RECORDING and RE-VALIDATION only; it changes no independent variable, no oracle and no prediction.

case_matrix.note: matrix_sha256 is recomputed by harness/run.py at the start of every gated run and written to raw/<run>/01_anchors.json + 02_summary.json; a mismatch between the two gated runs invalidates the capture.

git_rev_gate: NOT a gate. Per SUBAGENT_BRIEF, captures are validated against the AUTHORED BLOB HASHES below, not against live HEAD; the orchestrator commits sibling experiments continuously.

raw_schema.observed_encoding: concatenated big-endian-printed hex of the little-endian 32-bit output words actually read back, in buffer order

repetition.rationale: EXP-0113 found this family's spliced results nondeterministic across runs; the dispatch is repeated inside one process AND the whole capture is repeated in a second process launch.

target.note: local host only; A18 Pro HANDS-OFF; no SSH anywhere; no M5
